那是 什么

Thanks for the compliment! I’ve seen your posts lately and found you really interesting. If you’re willing to learn Chinese, that’s great. But my advice is that in most cases, you can still choose to use English. In fact, people will pay more attention to you if you speak English, and a lot of things might be easier to handle that way. The key thing is that the internet is really advanced now - there are tons of translation methods, and even using AI is a great option. It can help people understand what you mean more accurately. Just like when you tried to post this in Chinese earlier, I couldn’t make sense of what you were saying

给佬友们看中文原版:

感谢你的夸奖～
最近也看到过你的话题
觉得你还是挺有趣的

这是很棒的
但是我的建议是在大部分情况下还是可以选择使用英文的
反而用英文的话大家会更在意你
很多事情可能更好解决
最关键的是我们现在互联网很发达
翻译方法很多

可以更准确的去理解你的意思
就像你刚才使用中文尝试发这个帖子
我就看不懂你的表达了

posts.cookedHtml:
You mean filters! I actually already guessed it. Did I use any? Nope, not at all! Whether it’s in games or taking photos IRL, filters just feel totally unnecessary and cumbersome to me.
They’re so weird—they don’t just tweak the look a tiny bit; they completely flip the whole vibe. Like black-and-white or macaron filters? They instantly turn bright midday or cool blue sunny skies into drowsy, dusky sunset shots.
I hate ruining the original picture like that! Even when I use AI to edit my photos, I almost never let it mess up the original aesthetic I had.

中文：你说的是滤镜呀，其实我猜到了，至于用没用呢？当然是没有的，无论是游戏还是现实中拍照，滤镜这个东西在我看来总是那么的多余和累赘。它很奇怪，它带来的效果不是那么分毫的微调，而是整体画风大改，比如什么黑白滤镜 马卡龙滤镜都会瞬间把正午或者是蓝色基调的晴天变成昏昏欲睡的夕阳一样。我不喜欢这样破坏原图的事情，就像我用 AI 帮助我修改图片，基本上不会让它动我自己一样
